cards.title: Surviving Capability: Why the Field Celebrates What the Theory Condemns
cards.editorial_question: What makes an inherited capability worth keeping after its founding conditions change?

editorial_readings.label: Reusable capability
editorial_readings.reading: A useful function can sometimes outlive the tool or channel where it first appeared.

editorial_readings.label: Capability migration and value capture
editorial_readings.reading: Capability creation, carriers, operation and value capture can occur in different places.

editorial_readings.label: Cross-frontier activation
editorial_readings.reading: A need or capacity in one territory, community or technical domain can open another possibility.

editorial_readings.label: Outcome level and boundary
editorial_readings.reading: Locate a performance claim at task, team, organisation, network or programme level.

cards.title: Distributed Operational Intelligence Across the Americas
cards.editorial_question: How does operating meaning survive movement across an institutional border?

editorial_readings.label: Distributed continuity
editorial_readings.reading: Sustain an operation across places, times and organisations.

editorial_readings.label: Tiger Teams
editorial_readings.reading: Focused teams combine architecture, engineering, governance and operational delivery around a mission.

editorial_readings.label: Context handoff
editorial_readings.reading: Transfer evidence with meaning, limits and conditions for its receiving decision.

editorial_readings.label: Architecture decision
editorial_readings.reading: Change or preserve dependencies, applications and controls using evidence of capability and use.

cards.title: Case Study: Texas-to-Mexico Oilfield Services Transformation: Knowledge Transfer, Industrialization, and Compliance
cards.editorial_question: What lets a receiving operation exercise an imported capability independently?

editorial_readings.label: Audit readiness
editorial_readings.reading: Prepare process evidence and response capability for a defined review.

editorial_readings.label: Internal capability after exit
editorial_readings.reading: The recipient can operate, resolve exceptions and learn after the interveners leave.

editorial_readings.label: Legitimacy across an interface
editorial_readings.reading: A carrier needs enough recognition in both communities to sustain translation.

editorial_readings.label: Repeatable internal learning
editorial_readings.reading: Training, codification and practice can make an intervention reproducible.

cards.title: Field Intelligence in Chicontepec and the Texas–Mérida Corridor
cards.editorial_question: Which institutions can carry field knowledge across different operating contracts?

editorial_readings.label: Cross-territory architecture adaptation
editorial_readings.reading: Transfer a function while redesigning rules, support and incentives for the receiver.

editorial_readings.label: Capability migration and value capture
editorial_readings.reading: Capability creation, carriers, operation and value capture can occur in different places.

editorial_readings.label: Transmission of tacit judgment
editorial_readings.reading: People learn to recognise exceptions through situated practice.

editorial_readings.label: Cross-frontier activation
editorial_readings.reading: A need or capacity in one territory, community or technical domain can open another possibility.

intra_cluster_edges.reading: The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.
intra_cluster_edges.boundary: La preparación audit-ready descrita no equivale a certificación universal ni demuestra por sí sola autonomía futura de cada equipo.
